title: The L¹ tangent vector field Y dual to θ·ξ⌞ω on a rectifiable triple
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P, (M, θ, ξ) with IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ, and ω ∈ D^m(U). Then there is Y : ℝ^P → ℝ^P such that (a) Y is Hⁿ⌞M-integrable; (b) for every x ∈ ℝ^P and every continuous linear functional φ on ℝ^P, φ(Y(x)) = θ(x)·ξ(x)(alternatizeUncurryFin(φ.smulRight(ω(x)))) (i.e. φ(Y(x)) = θ(x)⟨φ∧ω(x), ξ(x)⟩); (c) for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M, Y(x) ∈ Q for every subspace Q which is a weighted approximate tangent plane of (M, θ) at x (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Q).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), IsRectifiableTriple U (m + 1) M θ ξ → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, ∃ Y : Eucl P → Eucl P, Integrable Y ((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) ∧ (∀ (x : Eucl P) (φ : Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ), φ (Y x) = θ x * ξ x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (φ.smulRight ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x)))) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt (m + 1) M θ x Q → Y x ∈ Q
